title: Surreal Arcade Battle
description: A surreal desert scene features a white boxing ring floating in the sky where a white mechanical spider fights a large purple horned robot monster wearing pink bunny ears, with a small green character in a pink shirt observing from the ring. Above them swirls a massive psychedelic rainbow vortex with a giant floating eye emitting blue tentacles, while below a gloved hand holds a retro handheld game console displaying 'VAULT-08877 STASIS LOCKED PAUSED' next to a battered arcade cabinet on a cracked desert road littered with bottles and debris.
